scope: Files produced for the 2026-09-25 freeze that are retained locally and not committed. Each was present in the working tree at inventory time and has a hash-verified copy under ${BULK} (the operator-supplied external artifact root), which is the authoritative retained copy; working-tree originals may have been removed during cleanup. Hashes are of the file bytes at inventory time. No circuit qualification is implied.
bulk_copy_note: Every bulk_copy was re-hashed after copying and matched sha256.
not_inventoried: Corrected 2026-09-25. Not inventoried, local only (gitignored, no bulk copy recorded here): (1) the 249 c1414 run progress files blocks/g1_top/sim/logs/*c1414*.progress.jsonl (1 599 880 571 bytes), the source of runner_sha256 cited in RESULTS_20260925.md; (2) the 855 c1414 waveform files under blocks/g1_top/sim/results/waves/ (444 .gz, 411 .txt; 4 537 545 900 bytes), whose hashes the run JSONs record; (3) the generated build decks under build/g1_top/*.cir (531 files at the time of the correction). The committed copies under blocks/g1_top/sim/decks/ are the record of each run's netlist (279/279 c1414 run JSONs hash-match their deck_sha256). The last chip-level run (b_s_tt_85C_r4_c1414m) finished before the final inventory and its log is included.
